publish.costHint: A frame of the film and your own image are free. An AI image joins the plan as a paid line.
publish.staleNotice: The marked fields are out of date with the changed plan. They are not rewritten on their own: edit them yourself or ask the assistant to rewrite the package.
publish.notPublishing: Approving the plan is not a permission to publish. Publishing needs its own permission.

errors.conflict: The package changed somewhere else. The newest version was read; make your edit again.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
errors.refused: This change does not fit the package (empty, placeholder or repeated text). It was not saved.
errors.unavailable: The publish package is off in this environment.
